description_en: Retrieves the information about a node security tuple ticket by ticket ID, including the processing status of the ticket
description_zh: 获取节点安全元组工单信息，传入工单 ID, 返回此工单的处理状态等信息
name: GetNodeTupleOrder

Data.description_en: The node security tuple ticket information
Data.description_zh: 节点安全元组工单信息

AcceptedMillis.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the ticket was approved, in milliseconds
AcceptedMillis.description_zh: 工单审批通过的 UNIX 时间戳，以毫秒为单位

CreatedMillis.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the ticket was committed, in milliseconds
CreatedMillis.description_zh: 提交工单的 UNIX 时间戳，以毫秒为单位

IsKpm.description_en: Indicates whether the key request was initiated from a security production line
IsKpm.description_zh: 是否是安全产线发起的密钥申请

OrderState.description_en:
The ticket status.

Valid values:

APPLYING: Pending approval.
ACCEPTING: Being issued.
ACCEPTED: Issued.
ACCEPTING_FAILED: Issuance failed.
REJECTED: Rejected.
REVOKING: Being revoked.
REVOKING_FAILED: Revocation failed.
REVOKED: Revoked
OrderState.description_zh:
工单状态。

审批状态取值

APPLYING申请中。
ACCEPTING颁发中。
ACCEPTED颁发成功。
ACCEPTING_FAILED颁发失败。
REJECTED已拒绝。
REVOKING撤回中。
REVOKING_FAILED撤回失败。
REVOKED撤回成功

RequiredCount.description_en: The number of node security keys requested in the ticket
RequiredCount.description_zh: 工单申请的节点安全密钥数量

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
